taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-15 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-15
Curve type: A-type (resistivity increases progressively with depth)
Aquifer depth: 7.42 – 25.09 m
Recommendation: The moderate-resistivity zone between ~7.4 m and 25.1 m (weathered/fractured horizon) is the most promising water-bearing interval; set well screens across this depth. Drilling beyond ~25 m enters highly resistive, likely unweathered bedrock and is unlikely to improve yield, so further penetration should be limited unless fracture zones are confirmed during drilling.
